prompt: In a photorealistic photo set within a lush botanical greenhouse, a woman in a blue dress stands on the left holding a small trowel. Next to her, a man in a green apron points at a large fern frond, directing her attention to its underside. In the center, a white cat sits calmly on a wooden bench, observing the scene with quiet curiosity. To the right of the bench, an elderly person in a straw hat looks at a blooming orchid with gentle admiration. Beside them, a child in yellow rain boots holds a watering can, ready to tend to the soil. The woman in the blue dress is handing the trowel to the man in the green apron, who accepts it with his free hand. The white cat remains still, neither moving nor reacting to the exchange. There is no visible glass reflection on the greenhouse panels. The spatial arrangement places the woman and man on the left, the cat in the center, and the elderly person and child on the right, creating a balanced composition within the verdant space.
